subject: science
concept: Sorting animals into basic groups (mammal, bird, fish, reptile, amphibian, insect)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts animal cards into group piles based on shared physical features
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an animal to its correct group label
exercise.abstract: Student names the animal group a described animal belongs to, based on its features

misconception_flags: sorts by habitat (e.g. 'lives in water') rather than actual biological group features

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
